description: This file defines a class 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Name' which is a subclass of 'HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy'. It includes properties and methods related to a deprecated 'name' attribute feature for certain HTML elements, used within the HTMLPurifier library for HTML sanitization.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Tidy_Name
classes.description: A class representing a deprecated but allowed 'name' attribute for certain HTML tags within the Tidy module of the HTMLPurifier library.

methods.name: makeFixes
methods.description: Creates and returns an array of attribute transformations for certain HTML tags, specifically handling the deprecated 'name' attribute for 'img' and 'a' elements.
